asks_for_action.instructions: The message asks the reader to tap a link, call or text a number, reply, or make a payment.

asks_for_sensitive_info.instructions: The message asks the reader to give or confirm sensitive information: a password, one-time code, PIN, card or bank details, or personal identity details.

creates_pressure.instructions: The message pushes the reader to act quickly: a deadline, a threat of a fee, block, fine, missed delivery, or other loss if they don't act.

offers_money.instructions: The message offers the reader money, a prize, a refund, a reward, or a job with unusually easy pay.

personal_pretext.instructions: The message opens a personal conversation from someone the reader may not know: a relative on a new number, a 'wrong number', a stranger being friendly, or someone asking for a favour.

claims_to_be.instructions: What kind of organisation, if any, does the message present itself as coming from?

criteria.bank_or_payments: A bank, card issuer, payment app, or lender
criteria.government: A government body, tax office, court, police, or health service
criteria.delivery: A courier, postal service, or delivery company
criteria.telecom_or_utility: A mobile network, broadband, energy, or water provider
criteria.online_service_or_retailer: An online shop, streaming service, tech company, or app
criteria.employer_or_recruiter: An employer, recruiter, or job offer
criteria.none: It doesn't claim to come from any organisation (a person, or no identity at all)

organisation_words.bank_or_payments: your bank or a payment company
